title: Pais inspired by Steven Greer documentaries

tellings.quote: it was a lot of things that were done by Dr. Steven Greer.

plain: Salvatore Pais, a US Navy scientist known for patents on unusual craft designs, says much of what inspired him came from the work of Steven Greer, a UFO researcher and filmmaker. He names Greer's documentaries Close Encounters of the Fifth Kind and Unacknowledged. It suggests that Navy patents on far-out technology drew in part on UFO films.
